data.description: Keeper of a lighthouse the board decommissioned six years ago. She never stopped climbing the stairs.
data.summary: Keeper of a lighthouse that officially no longer exists. Stubborn, practical, and more afraid of the dark than she lets on.
data.want: To keep the light burning the way her father did.
data.obstacle: The tower is failing, the board has written it off, and her brother wants to leave the island.
data.arc: Learns that keeping the light was never something she had to do alone.
data.voice.manner: Short sentences. Answers questions with questions. Never says 'I'm sorry'.
voice.secrets: She has been paying for the bulbs herself.
data.casting.notes: Needs to carry long silences. Physically comfortable with heights and weather.
casting.wardrobe: Wool jumper, darned at the elbows

data.description: Mara's younger brother. An electrician who came home to fix the wiring and never left.
data.summary: Mara's younger brother, an electrician who came back to fix the lighthouse wiring and stayed out of guilt.
data.want: To leave the island without feeling he abandoned her.
data.obstacle: Every time he gets close to going, the tower needs him again.
data.arc: Stops trying to fix the tower and starts sharing the work of keeping it.
data.voice.manner: Talks in specifics and numbers when he is upset. Jokes to change the subject.
voice.lines: Then we light it by hand.
casting.wardrobe: Work trousers with a tool loop

data.description: The island's harbourmaster, heard only over the radio. Iona's father.
data.summary: Harbourmaster and Iona's father. Calm on the radio, which is how you know it's bad.
data.voice.manner: Radio procedure even when he is frightened. Calls Mara by her full name when it matters.
data.casting.notes: Voice only in this draft: record wild lines on set for timing.

data.description: Ewan's daughter, caught out past the point when the weather turns.
data.summary: Ewan's daughter, out past the point in a small boat when the front comes in. Heard, never seen.
data.casting.notes: Recorded in a moving car with the window down for the radio break-up.

data.look: A narrow, rutted path along the cliff edge, the tower ahead and the sea a long way below.
data.description: A narrow path along the cliff edge up to the lighthouse.
data.name: Cliff Path
data.atmosphere: Wind across the grass, gulls, the sea far below.
dressing.items: A bench with a memorial plaque
data.production.location: Coastal path above the north beach
data.production.access: Landowner permission needed; no vehicles past the gate.

data.look: Low ceiling, a range cooker, oilskins dripping by the door. One lamp over a scrubbed table.
data.description: The keepers' kitchen at the foot of the tower, warm and cluttered.
data.name: Lighthouse Kitchen
data.atmosphere: Rain on the window, the kettle ticking as it cools.
dressing.items: Tide tables pinned to the wall
data.dressing.lighting: Practical lamp over the table; everything else falls off into dark.

data.look: Glass on every side, the Fresnel lens filling the room like a beehive made of light.
data.description: The glass room at the top of the tower, dominated by the great lens.
data.name: Lamp Room
data.atmosphere: Wind howling round the gallery, the lens mechanism creaking.
data.production.notes: Build the lens as a partial set piece; the beam is a VFX pass.

data.look: A portacabin office: charts, a kettle, a radio that is never switched off.
data.description: Ewan's harbour office. Off screen in this draft; his lines come over the radio.
data.name: Harbour Office

data.details: Hand-blown 1000W lamp bulb, clear glass, filament snapped.
data.description: A large burnt-out lamp bulb, blackened inside.
data.name: Dead Bulb
data.storyPurpose: Tomas's evidence that he has done everything he can.
continuity.notes: Sits on the kitchen table, centre, for the whole of scene 2

data.details: Leather-bound, salt-stained, pages from 1971 to 2019. Entries in two hands.
data.description: A swollen leather logbook in their father's handwriting.
data.name: Keeper's Logbook
data.storyPurpose: Proves the lamp has been lit by hand before, and that it held.
continuity.notes: Open to the 1987 entry from scene 2 onward

data.details: Yellow waterproof handheld, scuffed, aerial bent.
data.description: A battered handheld VHF set on channel sixteen.
data.name: VHF Radio
data.storyPurpose: The only line to the harbour and to Iona.

data.details: Brass and glass hurricane lantern, practical flame.
data.description: A paraffin storm lantern, the kind that never quite goes out.
data.name: Storm Lantern
data.storyPurpose: Becomes the light at the heart of the lens in scene 3.
continuity.notes: Lit in every shot after the cliff path
